name: Spatial4D-Bench-routeplan
description: Spatial4D-Bench-routeplan evaluates models' ability to perform route planning and trajectory prediction in spatio-temporal (4D) environments. It provides scenarios with spatial layouts and temporal constraints and measures whether models can produce valid, efficient routes. The benchmark is intended for research on navigation, motion planning, and spatio-temporal reasoning.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (planned route success) and path-efficiency metrics
general_score_metric: route success rate (with secondary metrics: path efficiency / deviation)
reputation: Niche/specialized dataset on Hugging Face for research in spatial-temporal planning; limited but focused community use.
